title: Freyalise Casts the World Spell
summary: A vast magical undertaking helps bring Dominaria’s Ice Age to an end.
narrative: The Ice Age was sustained by more than ordinary climate conditions. Magical disruptions continued to affect the plane long after the Brothers’ War.
Freyalise’s World Spell played a decisive role in ending that era, allowing Dominaria to move toward a period of thaw and renewal.

The supernatural winter cannot be treated as a single bad season. Earlier magical catastrophe had disrupted Dominaria at a planetary scale, and generations of communities organized their lives around conditions they could not control. The accumulated social and political effects mattered even where the immediate causes were no longer visible.

Freyalise's intervention belongs to the end of this long magical condition rather than to an ordinary change in weather. The spell helped remove the conditions sustaining the Ice Age, but thaw did not instantly reverse centuries of lost knowledge, ruined settlements, or struggles for power. It created possibilities for renewal without restoring an earlier world intact.

Freyalise later appears in the Mending crisis as a protector whose obligations to elven communities remain central. Reading these two episodes together reveals a recurring pattern in her history: immense magical power is important, but the lasting measure of that power is what happens to the peoples and places she chooses to protect.
